headlines: S-1: as of September 30, Anthropic had 11,900+ customers spending $100,000+ annually, 1,900+ customers spending $1M+, and 250 customers spending $10M+ (Rebecca Bellan/TechCrunch)

S-1: Anthropic outlines its mission to revolutionize sectors like medicine and warns its corporate behavior may diverge from traditional profit-maximization (Robert Hart/The Verge)
Anthropic S-1: of its $81B net loss in H1 2026, over $72B was related to changes in the value of convertible notes as the company's valuation increased (Financial Times)
Anthropic S-1: an $80.7B net loss on revenue of $16.3B in H1 2026, up from a $13B net loss on revenue of $1.2B in H1 2025, and a net revenue retention of 900% (Bloomberg)
